description: Polyphonic voltmeter, sample and hold and random voltage source: sixteen values are shown on the display and sent out of one polyphonic cable.

params.text: Acts as one clock event for the active clock mode, updating the values by hand.
Clears all sixteen displayed and output values to 0V.
Picks which channel of the clock input is read in Single-Channel clock mode.
Picks which channel of the value input is read in Single-Channel input mode.
Steps the input mode through Single-Channel, reading one chosen channel of the value input; Internal, random voltages made inside the module; and Polyphonic, each value channel feeding its own line.
Steps the clock mode through Single-Channel, reading one chosen channel of the clock input; Internal, updating at audio rate with no clock; and Polyphonic, each clock channel updating its own line.

inputs.text: The signal being measured or sampled; in Polyphonic input mode each channel feeds the line of the same number.
A trigger updates the displayed and output values; in Polyphonic clock mode each channel updates the line of the same number.
A trigger clears all sixteen displayed and output values to 0V.

outputs.text: Carries the sixteen displayed values, one per polyphonic channel.

notes: four small marks are printed beside the top of the display, reading TXT, UNI, SVL and Thm; left-clicking one opens its own menu for the visual mode, the bar mode, the opacities and the theme.
menu: Random Generator Range — sets the voltages used by Internal input mode and by Rack's Randomize: 0-10V, -5V to +5V, 0-5V, 0-1V, -1V to +1V, -10V to +10V, -2V to +2V, or 0-2V.
Show Clock Blinkers — turns the clock activity marks behind the display lines on or off.
Visual — holds Bar Mode, set to Unipolar or Bipolar, and sliders for Text Opacity and Bars Opacity.
Clock Mode — Single-Channel, Internal or Polyphonic, the same setting as the clock mode button on the panel.
Input Mode — Single-Channel, Internal or Polyphonic, the same setting as the input mode button on the panel.
Theme — picks the colours the display is drawn in: Boldy, Poloneck, Hut, Typhus, Moss, Check, Gratings, Ant or Santana.

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
